dct_description_sm: The Toronto Port Authority Annual Public Opinion Survey assess various views on the Port Authority's operations, activities and proposed undertakings. It focuses on Torontonians' attitudes toward the Port Authority and its airport.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
